_comment: TEMPLATE layout for Oshiire archiving. COMMITTED to the repo as documentation of the format. Copy this to layout.json (which is gitignored) and fill in YOUR real archive. Style per franchise: 'nested' = Franchise/Character/ subfolders; 'flat' = everything in Franchise/ with no subfolders; 'shortname' = art from a lightly-collected series goes in a shared folder with a _SHORTNAME suffix in the filename, decoded by the shortname file. Unmatched characters are flagged in the review UI, never auto-created. Aliases map the franchise/character names your tagger produces to the actual folder names on disk.
